profile.headline: Hands-on AI/ML Leader · PhD
profile.summary:
I am a hands-on AI/ML leader who guides teams to deploy data-driven systems that solve real-world problems. Mentoring data scientists, identifying the right features for a model, writing efficient and readable code, using RAG and MCP to build unique and high-impact Generative AI tools, visualizing data, and aligning AI/ML systems with business priorities are all challenges that motivate me on a daily basis.

I have 10+ years experience building and iterating on systems that use data, statistics, and machine learning to answer difficult and important questions.  Through teaching, working with business stakeholders, presenting, publishing, and writing clear code, I have developed exceptional communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.

I’m excited about opportunities to build robust and useful AI/ML systems, make positive impacts with data, lead teams of ML practitioners, and continue learning and growing.

positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · On-site

positions.title: Data Science Manager
positions.description:
Clayco is a multi-billion dollar enterprise providing integrated building solutions for their clients' most difficult projects.

I established and managed the Data Science team as part of Clayco's Data Analytics and Engineering group. I managed and trained four data scientists, none of whom had prior professional experience in the field. In my 2+ years leading the team, we put multiple models into production, created robust ETL and CI/CD pipelines, guided executives on the promise and peril of AI solutions, and cut software costs by building a containerized ML platform on AWS.

As a hands-on leader, I worked with our data, code, and systems day in and day out. I focused on specific problems and also considered the broad perspective of how my team's work could best support the business. I prioritized the success of my direct reports, investing time into teaching and mentoring them to become better data scientists.

Highlights:
* Collaborated with business stakeholders to translate business needs into deliverable machine learning products.
* Managed and trained four data scientists and led the data science internship program.
* Delivered AI/ML solutions for cash flow forecasting, safety risk prediction, cost control, and contract analysis.
* Defined standard operating procedures and set quality standards for the data science team.
* Designed and built a containerized ML platform on AWS to reduce our Software-as-a-service expenses.
* Deployed multiple productionalized ML pipelines with automated scoring, retraining, monitoring, and versioning.
* Used explainable AI techniques to provide actionable insights on safety risks.
* Automated project-management work on GitHub to reduce cognitive overhead and keep the team focused on ML work.
* Built a proof-of-concept RAG pipeline for using generative AI to analyze contracts.

positions.title: Senior Data Scientist
positions.description: Skills: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · Docker · Generative AI · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · XGBoost · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
Decide is an ad platform that uses machine learning and AI to optimize returns from advertisements for both brands and publishers.

As a Machine Learning Engineer, I design, evaluate, and deploy models that maximize the revenue Decide generates for its brand and publisher partners. My models combine modern machine learning tools with decision making processes rooted in core business goals, giving them the power and stability necessary to succeed in production.

I also develop many aspects of our machine learning environment, including data import and cleaning, codebase management, model specification, and performance monitoring. 

Highlights:
* Increased performance for a top publisher with a model that aggregates historical data to reduce variance.
* Deployed an Autoencoders to identify performant ads in segments with few clicks and conversions.
* Introduced new metrics to support modeling for programmatic placements (i.e., where Decide must compete in an auction to show an ad).
* Built tools that simplify the process of evaluating TensorFlow models' performance before going into production
* Accelerated the development of the ETL pipeline that Decide uses to get data from BigQuery and third-party APIs into our machine learning environment.
* Wrote scripts that automate dependency management and style checking for Decide's R and Python codebases.
* Voted team MVP by colleagues for Q4 2021-Q1 2022.

Tools: TensorFlow, Python, R, SQL, GCP, git, Docker, Airflow, Bash, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost

Methodologies: Machine Learning, Statistics & Probability, AI, Data Visualization, Object-Oriented Programming, Functional Programming, Unit-Testing

positions.title: Postdoctoral Fellow
positions.description:
I am responsible for designing and implementing quantitative research projects on immigration, public policy, and political behavior. I have worked closely with stakeholders to translate research into policy with real-world impacts.

Highlights:
* Developed a partnership with the City of Zurich based on using data science to expand their immigrant outreach efforts.
* Implemented a randomized control trial to understand effects of letter campaigns on naturalization
* Analyzed large administrative data sets with causal inference and machine learning techniques over the cloud
* Managed complex survey projects through design, data collection, analysis, and reporting
* Produced outputs including scientific publications, policy briefs, presentations and media coverage of my research
positions.insights: Skills: Causal Inference · Research Design · Project Management · Scientific Writing · Policy Analysis

positions.title: Postdoctoral Fellow
positions.description: I taught masters-level courses in data science. For these courses, I designed and lead tutorials introducing students to coding in R, statistics and probability, and causal inference with experimental and observational data.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Causal Inference · Statistics · R (Programming Language) · Communication
